policy_tiers_per_revision.rule: a valid policy must still define at least one tier for every supported base severity and all generated Non-fault tiers

batch_classification_targets.authoritative_total: exact count separate from rendered page
batch_classification_targets.mutation: one independently auditable result per target; no silent skip

report_member_staging_batch.rule: staging batches never alter operational state and must remain within LLD-01 short-writer thresholds

percentage.input_scale: at most 6 decimal places in percentage units
percentage.comparison: integer cross-multiplication only; never binary floating point

duration.input: exact decimal days/hours accepted only when conversion yields an integral number of seconds; no rounding
duration.source_suspension: ExactDuration rational seconds numerator/positive denominator supplied by source owner; canonical reduction required
duration.arithmetic: integer/rational exact comparison; clamp elapsed at zero before tier comparison

reporting.timezone: America/Guayaquil fixed for SLA cohort and reporting-period authority
reporting.snapshot_members: bounded by available local storage rather than product row cap; generated/persisted in bounded batches with exact totals
reporting.failed_attempt_retention: retain bounded attempt metadata/audit only; staged member/result payload is removed after terminal failed/cancelled handling

performance.classification_write: indexed point/current-customer/CPL checks only inside writer transaction
performance.cohort_query: indexed Report-Date month + classification + severity/policy partition; never full-table Python filtering
performance.report_generation: stable accepted-state snapshot materialized to bounded staging before XLSX generation; no long writer transaction
